Test Case Title: Representative: Read-only Front Desk role — view WO/Customers/Schedule, no edits, no financials
Preconditions: Logged in as an Administrator with full access. Application is on the Custom Roles & Permissions build (Epic SV-7388, SV-7500 enabled). At least one test staff member exists to receive the role. A second browser/session is available to log in as the test staff user. NOTE (permission propagation): after assigning the role, log out and log back in as the user (fresh login) so the new permissions load; allow a brief settle before verifying.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
1. Navigate Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role. Start from a blank/minimal baseline (all toggles OFF). Name the role 'Read-only Front Desk'. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Enable only Work Orders > View, Customers > View, Schedule > View. Leave all else OFF.
3. Save the role, then go Administration > Staff > open the test user > assign role 'Read-only Front Desk' > Create.
4. In a separate browser, log in as the test staff user.
5. POSITIVE: Open Work Orders, Customers, and Schedule from nav.
6. POSITIVE: Attempt to find create/edit/delete controls in WO, Customers, Schedule.
7. NEGATIVE (aggregate): Check nav for Invoicing, Parts, Catalog, Vendor, Reports, Timesheets, History Logs, Administration, and any financial figures.
Expected Result: User can only view Work Orders, Customers, and Schedule. All other areas hidden, no edit capability, no financial data visible. Access equals exactly the granted union.
Actual Result (Observed): Tech effective permissions EXACTLY match the combined set (4 codes incl. view-mode marker). Granted: Customers View, Schedule View, WO View. No extra/leaked areas; ungranted areas absent.
Status Rationale: Actual behavior matched the expected result (actual == expected). PUT 200, assign 201, stored view_mode=full. Effective set equals stored role set (backend has no server-side cascade; UI cascade/gate pre-resolved into the PUT set, confirmed in prior VIU). fe-permissions verified as Tech via dev-login.
Spec / Requirement Reference: SV-7500, SV-7388 (Work Orders, Customers, Schedule) · WO View + Customers View + Schedule View, no create/edit/delete, financials OFF
